_comment: Read from the plugin install path by kiln-doctor — NOT copied into consumer projects. Version-keyed health checks. kiln-doctor merges entries from 1.0.0 through the current config_version, runs each, and renders a | Check | Status | Fix | table. New system components ship as new version entries here — no kiln-doctor code change needed. Order: required -> version_checks -> optional. Required failures are errors (non-zero exit); optional failures are warnings (exit 0).
